hazards.title: Unprotected leading edge
hazards.description: Worker exposed at unprotected side/edge greater than 6 feet above a lower level.
hazards.corrective_action: Install a guardrail system or personal fall arrest before continuing work.
hazards.audio_response_script: Critical fall hazard at the leading edge. OSHA 1926.501 requires fall protection above six feet. Install a guardrail or personal fall arrest system immediately.

hazards.title: Portable ladder not extended above landing
hazards.description: Access ladder does not extend at least 3 feet (36 inches) above the upper landing surface.
hazards.corrective_action: Reposition or replace the ladder so side rails extend 36 inches above the landing and secure it against displacement.
hazards.audio_response_script: High severity ladder hazard. 1926.1053 requires three feet of extension above the landing. Extend and secure the ladder before the next climb.

hazards.title: Missing hard hat in active work zone
hazards.description: Personnel observed in an area with potential head injury from impact or falling objects without hard hats.
hazards.corrective_action: Stop work in the zone until all crew members don compliant hard hats.
hazards.audio_response_script: Medium PPE finding under 1926.100. Hard hats are required where head injury is possible. Issue helmets and resume only when the crew is protected.

audio_response_script: Inspection complete. Overall risk score is seventy-three, high. Address the unprotected leading edge before resuming work.
